            return

        rspIns1, _ := poc.ParseBytesToHTTPResponse(resultResponse)
        if rspIns1 != nil {
            yakit.Info("[%v] %v: %v", rspIns1.StatusCode, addr, path)

            url, _ = str.ExtractURLFromHTTPRequestRaw(resultRequest, isTls)

            _, check404 = standard404Map.Load(addr)
            if check404 {
                if rspIns1.StatusCode == 404 {
                    return
                } else {
                    addTable(url.String(), rspIns1.StatusCode, len(body), title)
                }
                return
            }

            // 非标准404
            rspOrigin, ok = sample404Map.Load(addr)

                if judge.CompareRaw(rspOrigin, resultResponse) > 0.85 {
                    return
                }
                addTable(url.String(), rspIns1.StatusCode, len(body), title)

            if rspIns1.StatusCode != 404 {
                addTable(url.String(), rspIns1.StatusCode, len(body), title)
            }
        }
    }
}
